canonical_project: AtlasEdge Lisbon campus LIS001 / LIS002 / LIS003
notes: AtlasEdge Lisbon campus at Estrada Outurela 117a, Carnaxide (Oeiras, Grande Lisboa). LIS001 operational with 5.1 MW / 3,162 m2 data centre space, first customers installed; LIS002 in master planning (16 MW / 24 MVA, RFS 2028); LIS003 planned on adjacent 10,000 m2 plot; campus target up to 30 MW across three phases; EUR 253M green financing secured. Campus is in Lisbon district (Oeiras/Carnaxide).
